$comment: Vommet's "What's new" list, shown after an update (every entry newer than the build the user last opened) and under Settings › About › What's New. The sync session adds ONE entry at the TOP when it cuts a testing build: "date" = the cut time in UTC (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-07T21:40:00Z), "changes" = one short sentence per change testers can notice, in plain language (what changed for them, not how). Leave out internal-only changes (CI, refactors, tests). Newest entry first.

changes: Screen-share audio from other apps and relays now stops when you stop watching the stream, and "Mute stream" and the stream's volume work on it.
Color chat wallpapers can show Telegram's doodle pattern over the colors, with a strength slider.
The Media and Files tabs of encrypted chats now load from the local search index, much faster.

Long-press or right-click Send to send with an effect (confetti, fireworks, hearts, snow, rain, space invaders, hug, cuddle, googly eyes); Element's fireworks, rainfall and hearts now play when you receive them, and reactions burst briefly when they arrive.

Double-tap a message (double-click on a computer) to react, reply or edit; pick the action and the reaction in Settings › Appearance › Double-tap. Phones react with a heart by default, computers do nothing until you pick.

Linux: what your music or video app is playing now shows above your name, with play/pause, previous and next; click it to bring the app up, and use the dots to switch between apps. Nothing is shared with anyone; switch it off in Settings › Appearance › Now playing.

New "Translate button on messages" switch in Settings › App › Translation: turn it off to hide the Translate button under other people's messages (and voice transcripts); rooms with "Translate this room" on still translate.
Deep Search finds messages, files and links across every chat, combining the on-device index with server search, and shows how much of your history is covered.

Videos can pop out into a small floating window (the picture-in-picture button on a video, or in full-screen view) that keeps playing while you move around the app: drag it to any corner, resize it, double-click for full screen, or jump back to the message it came from.
Pictures, videos and files from encrypted chats are now stored encrypted on your device, and the media cache moved out of the shared temporary folder into the app's own private folder.

Scheduled send: send a message later from the + menu (Discord style) or by right-clicking or long-pressing Send (Telegram style; both in Custom), then send now, edit, reschedule or delete it from the bar above the message box. Your homeserver holds it (delayed events), so on servers without them the option is grayed out and explains why.
You can now set your own picture per space and per room, next to the per-place nickname (experiment "Nickname and picture per space and room").
macOS and iOS now show notifications for new messages and calls while Vommet is running (no push yet, so none while it's closed).
Pictures opened from the Media tab keep their left and right arrows (and Jump to message), including older ones found by scrolling.

Chat navigation: @ and ♥ buttons jump to unread mentions and new reactions on your messages; jump to any date from a date divider, the room menu or search; see when a DM partner read your message; optional seconds in message times; and an edit history with highlighted changes.

Telegram themes: Telegram's eight built-in themes (Desktop Classic, Day, Tinted, Night; Android Blue, Arctic Blue, Dark Blue, Night) with accent colors and Telegram's doodle pattern behind the messages, a bubble-corner slider and a pattern/background section in the theme editor, and the + button now imports Telegram theme files (.tdesktop-theme, .zip, .attheme) into the editor.
Chat wallpapers can now be a color or a moving gradient, can be set by admins in group chats, and can be set just for yourself.

New privacy settings: Ghost mode (no read receipts or typing indicator anywhere, one switch), Clean links I send (tracking parameters are removed from links you send), and Message filters (hide messages matching words, phrases or regexes, on your account only).

Quick replies: save replies you send often and type / plus their name to drop one into the message box, ready to edit; manage them in Settings › Account › Quick replies, or save one of your own messages from its menu.
Saved messages: save any message with tags and a note from its menu, then find it again from the bookmarks button in the room header, filtered by tag; tapping one jumps to the message.

New Home's search box ranks every room you're in by name (start of the name first, then word starts, newest first) and groups the rest by space, tag and topic; type or pick a space, tag or "DMs" to search inside it, and use the arrow keys, Enter and Esc. The quick switcher ranks the same way.
Redacted mode now also blurs room and space banners, stickers, custom emoji and room directory pictures, and hides names and text in room event lines, emotes and in-chat search results.

Redacted mode switches on and off in one step: Ctrl+Shift+H, the account menu, the Ctrl+K switcher or the quick profile card. While it's on, an amber "Redacted" pill shows; tap it to turn redacted mode off.

Phone message box redesign: formatting buttons appear when you select text (or always, with the new "Formatting toolbar" switch in the + menu), and the translate button (now in every room, off until turned on in Settings) translates each paragraph into its own language when you send, with a "Will send" preview on long-press and "Sent in Spanish + German" under your message.
Four new app icon colors to pick from in Settings: Midnight, Mono, Sunset and Pastel (Android, Windows, Linux and macOS; on iOS only the V and original icons for now).

Calls now show how long they have been going: in the calls panel and call cards (since you joined), and in the "in a call" bar above a room and a voice room's line in the chat list (since the call began, even before you join).

When you have more than one direct message room with someone, the lists now show them once (their newest chat, with all unread counts added up); a ×2 chip, a "2 chats" chip in the chat header and the row's menu let you switch between them, and "Message" on a profile opens the newest one.

New room info page (an experiment, on by default, can be switched off in Experiments): tap a room's name to see everything about it on one page (on a computer, a dialog with About, Members, Shared and Settings tabs): shared media, files and links, members, settings just for you and the room's settings, plus Report room and Share room link.

With the new room info page on, a space's settings button opens a Space info page too: its rooms (suggested first, with Join buttons), members, your notification level and nickname for the space, and its settings.

With the new room info page on, direct chats follow who is in them: a direct chat that grows to three or more people becomes a group (with "Name this group" and "Move to Rooms"), a partner who leaves shows as "left this chat" with Invite back, and adding people to a direct chat offers to start a new group instead.

On phones, a call you're in stays reachable from other rooms and space pages: a slim bar under the header with hold to talk (or mute), camera and hang up (tap its name to go back to the call); with push to talk on, the call card, calls panel and typing bar get the Hold to talk pill too.

Calls use less data on mobile data and roaming (Settings › Data and storage › Calls: Never / Roaming only / Mobile data and roaming / Always): a smaller camera and screen share, lower-bitrate voice and lower-quality incoming video, with a "Saving data" label in the call panel.

New Home's "Standalone rooms" section and card become "Rooms": pick standalone rooms, rooms from all spaces, only some spaces or all but some, direct messages and tags, order them by space or newest first, and give the section its own name.
With Redacted mode on, system notifications follow it too: names, room names and message text are hidden or scrambled as set, and no avatar or picture is shown.
Redacted mode now also covers calls, profiles, the chat list, the quick switcher, room and space pickers, who reacted, read receipts and room previews.
The encrypted search index now also covers all DMs, finds words and word starts much faster with full-text search, and pauses on battery saver.
On Android, starting the app from a notification for another account's room now asks to switch accounts instead of ignoring the room.
On Android 9 and newer, HEIC pictures (and AVIF on Android 12+) now show as pictures, even without a preview from the sender, instead of as files.
On Android, when an update made Vommet register with your UnifiedPush distributor again, the old unused registration is now removed instead of staying listed in the distributor app.
Link previews the sender's app attached no longer ask "Show link previews from …?" in unencrypted chats; the card is only shown in encrypted chats.
Member list role headers now show a room's power level tag color and emoji or image icon, with the color adjusted to stay readable in light and dark themes.
Messages that failed to decrypt now also fix themselves in rooms you open after verifying this device or restoring your key backup.
Spanish is now offered as Spanish (Latin America) and Spanish (Spain) in the app language list, chosen automatically from your device's region.
Self-hosters get a ready-made Kubernetes (kustomize) setup for the Vommet web app in contrib/k8s.
In the Linux AppImage, clicking Open on a link now opens it in your browser.
The picture viewer opened from the Media tab has "Jump to message" in its menu, which closes the viewer and shows the picture's message in the chat.
A room's notification settings now start with "Use default (…)", which follows your account's defaults, and the other choices stay set for that room even when your defaults change.
Messages that arrive before their keys now notify when the keys come in, even when several are waiting for different keys.

Automatic media download gets a "When roaming" choice on Android (off by default) and a size limit per connection (2 MB on mobile data by default): bigger photos and GIFs wait for a tap. On Linux and Windows, a connection the system marks as metered now uses the mobile data choices.
Rooms search in the new Home shows each room's picture, with a small badge for voice, photo and calendar rooms.
The Media tab in unencrypted rooms loads small server thumbnails instead of full pictures and finds older pictures and files much faster.
Fixed an occasional error when a tooltip's button disappeared while the tooltip was showing.
On phones, a long message you're typing now uses the full width of the box: the translate, format and emoji buttons move to a small row under the text once it wraps.
The member list can hide offline members: use the dashed row under the list (or Settings › Layout › Hide offline members); it stays that way in every room.
In a voice room's list of people, the right-click option that clears a call you were left stuck in (e.g. after a crash) now shows only on your own name and is called "Remove from call".
In the Telegram-style chat list, favorite chats now show at the top, right under your pinned chats.
In the Telegram-style chat list, a chat's menu now says "Pin to top" instead of "Pin to sidebar".

The media viewer now has a ⋮ button in its top-right corner for pictures and videos, with Save as… and Share (the phone's share sheet); videos can now be saved and shared too. The button fades away while you zoom in.

Share your sticker rooms from the Library: keep them private, let people follow them for live updates, or let contributors you pick edit them; follow a pack from a sticker in chat or from a link, make your own copy of a pack you follow, send a friend a copy of selected stickers, and see which followed packs changed since you last looked.

Signing out of an account now asks first, and on your last device warns that your encrypted history would be lost, with ways to keep it: check your recovery key, save a key file, or turn on message backup.
Messages from bridges and other apps that put line breaks inside their formatted text no longer show extra blank lines, especially in quotes.
/me messages now show their formatting (colors, links, mentions) at normal text size, and the new /rainbowme sends a rainbow /me.
Sharing a Telegram or Signal sticker pack link into Vommet now opens the pack import dialog with it loaded, and tapping such a link in a message offers to import it.
Messages from people who left, were kicked or were banned keep the name and picture they had in the room, instead of their ID or global profile.
The web app can now show browser notifications for new messages, invites and calls while its tab is open: it asks once after sign-in, and Settings › Notifications has an Enable button.

Getting started is now a short click-through tour over the app itself (spaces, Browse rooms, chat, voice, Home, help); new users are offered it once, and Settings › Guides › Take the tour restarts it.

When sending a picture you can switch on "Send smaller" to resize it before it goes, and see how much it saves first. Phones do this on mobile data by default; change it in Settings › Data and storage › Sending pictures.
A room you leave in a space stays listed in that space with a Join button, so you can rejoin it.
A classic 1:1 call now ends cleanly when no TURN server is available, instead of crashing the app.
In an encrypted room where encryption couldn't start on this device, the message box now says so instead of claiming you don't have permission to send.
Typing dots in the room list now stop once someone stops typing, even when the "stopped typing" update gets lost, so Home and space views no longer keep the window repainting.
Web: your chosen microphone and speaker are remembered across reloads and used in calls; browsers that can't switch speakers no longer show a speaker picker.

Link previews that someone's app attaches now say whose app made them, can be trusted per person ("Always from…", "Never in this chat", or from their profile), warn when a preview claims a different site than the link, and in unencrypted chats your homeserver's preview is used first.

New Library page (Settings › Account › Emoji & Stickers, or Manage in the picker) to organize stickers and emoji: select items to move, copy, clone, reorder or delete them across your packs, and sort My GIFs into folders, including "Save to folder…" on a GIF in chat.

On a phone, zooming in on a picture or video in the media viewer now hides the status and navigation bars too, and videos get a full screen button next to the volume button (leave it with the same button or the back gesture).
On macOS, Pick image (profile picture and banner) and the other file pickers and Save as dialogs open again.
Your own profile's ⋮ menu in Settings now has "Change profile picture", next to Change display name.
On phones, sheets sit right above the keyboard again when the UI scale isn't 100%.
The cutefunny.art entry in the sign-up server list now mentions that the server doesn't accept sign-ups over a VPN.
New in Settings › Privacy: open YouTube, X, Reddit and other links on privacy-friendly frontends like Invidious, Nitter and Redlib, only for you (off by default).
With YouTube set to open on Invidious (Settings › Privacy), YouTube links now play right in the chat, with fullscreen and buttons to open them on YouTube or Invidious.

Settings › Appearance › Layout: the one "Discord-style layout" switch is now seven plainly named options (shrinking banners, member list grouping, who's in the call, member panel tabs, resizable panels, space home page, unread DMs on Home) under a Customize section, so picking Discord or Telegram style stays one tap; the Custom card gets its own preview and Telegram style is marked Beta. Your current setup carries over.

New experiment "Chat wallpapers" (on by default): give a 1:1 chat a wallpaper you both see, with darker/lighter and blur sliders, a preview and a Recent list. Find it in the room menu or the chat's Appearance settings; you can hide it for yourself.
Settings › Notifications now has separate rows for being tagged and for your name appearing in a message, and a room's notification setting shows when it follows your default.

In the Picture gallery on a phone, the swipe-up grid now follows your finger as you drag it open or closed, and you can pinch the grid to make its thumbnails bigger or smaller (the size is remembered, shared with the Media tab).
On Android, the buttons at the bottom of the "Join space" room picker no longer sit under the phone's navigation bar.

Desktop no longer notifies for messages in big rooms set to mentions only, keywords now notify in rooms set to Mentions & Keywords, and mentions and keywords in encrypted rooms notify on desktop again.
Saving a GIF from an encrypted room to My GIFs now asks first and saves an unencrypted copy, so its decryption key is no longer stored on your server.
Settings › General › Language is now one row with your language; tap it to pick another from a searchable list.
Sticker pack import hides "Select Files" once you paste a pack link, so the next step is clearly importing the link.
Message translation now works on Windows too, on the PC itself (needs testing by someone with a Windows PC).

Translate what you write: a Translate button in DMs turns your draft into the other person's language before you send it, and a new "Translate this room" mode (room menu, 文A) shows a room's messages in your language as you scroll and sends what you write in the room's language.

Windows: Vommet now has a proper installer (Start menu, desktop shortcut, uninstall in Apps), and installed copies update themselves: tap Update, then Restart to update. Portable-zip users: Update now moves you to the installed version, and offers to remove the old folder and its desktop shortcut.
Direct messages show their numbered (red, for noisy chats) badge again instead of a gray dot when their members haven't loaded yet, such as after catching up on messages received while offline.

In the Discord-style layout, a Media tab you widened by dragging now keeps its size as a share of the window, so it shrinks with the window instead of crowding the chat (the member list and other tabs keep their width).
Reacting to one picture of a picture mosaic: the picture you're reacting to is ringed (the others dim while you pick an emoji), its reactions show on it, and the mosaic no longer splits apart.
A picture mosaic's menu now has "Forward all" and "Save all" beside the one-picture Forward and Save.
Emoji and sticker packs now also use the names the Matrix spec gave them, so packs made in Vommet show up in clients that follow the spec and vice versa, and a pack keeps its order everywhere.

Stickers you send only name their pack when its room is public or knockable (or is the room you send to), so private sticker rooms stay private, and they also name it in the format other clients understand.

You can now share an encrypted room's earlier messages with someone however they joined: "Share history…" in their menu or profile card (one room or the whole space), a tick in the space invite dialog for rooms they're already in, and Settings › Security lists what you've shared with a Stop button; history shared by someone you haven't verified waits until you verify them.
A call whose connection drops for good now ends instead of staying open, and hanging up always ends a call even while offline.

Docked widgets, Redacted mode, Nickname per space and room, and Read state per thread are now on by default (you can still switch them off on the Experiments page). The old Friends tab is gone: the people you added are in New Home's People.
On iOS, saving a theme in the theme editor no longer shows a "File system watching is not supported" error.
Opening a room or loading older messages on desktop no longer stutters while every message row loads all your emoji packs; the reaction picker now loads them when it opens.
An open thread no longer loses or mixes up replies when several messages arrive at once.

Link previews now have one setting for all chats in Settings › Privacy: Automatic (previews the sender attached in encrypted chats, plus homeserver previews in other chats unless the room turns them off), Bundled only, Bundled + homeserver previews, or Off. Each room can pick its own in its settings.

With the Picture gallery experiment on a phone, swipe up on the thumbnail strip (or its new white handle) to open a grid of the room's pictures and videos under the one you're viewing; drag its handle down to go back to the strip.
In the picture gallery, the mouse wheel and dragging on the thumbnail strip now only scroll it; the shown picture changes only when you click or tap a thumbnail.
The Rainbow V is now the default icon everywhere, including your launcher and app menu.
The Getting started pictures now fill the page instead of staying small.

Picture mosaics now show every picture's read receipts, pin mark and "New messages" line, jumping to any picture highlights the mosaic, selecting a mosaic includes all its pictures, and a picture that starts a thread stays on its own so its thread shows.
First-time setup's People and Rooms button switches now show what your account's synced Home layout already has.

A space's invite and the invites to its rooms now show as one invite: open it to pick which rooms to join (all ticked), or Decline all. Rooms you untick stay as invites, so joining them later still brings their history.
Transcribed voice messages show which language they were in, and ones in another language can be translated on your device, like text messages.

Settings › Notifications shows your account's notification rules as an Off/On/Noisy grid, the same rules Element shows: one-to-one and group chats, mentions, @room, keywords (add and remove them here), invites, calls, bot messages and room upgrades.
A notification plays its sound only when its notification rule is set to Noisy; rules set to On now notify silently.
Mark all as read, per account in Settings › Notifications and from the Home button's menu, after a confirmation.
Settings › Appearance has a new "Image size in the timeline" choice: Default (as before) or Large, which shows pictures, picture mosaics and video previews as wide as the chat.

Translate messages on this device: a Translate button under messages in other languages shows the translation below the original (models download once after you confirm; choose your language and delete models in Settings > App > Translation).

Twelve experiments are now regular features, and Noise suppression, Automatic gain control, Newest unread DMs first, Discord-style layout, Sliding sync, Secure messaging setup and Show deleted messages moved from Experiments to ordinary settings (your choices carry over). New Home is now on for everyone; you can still switch it off.
New Home: pick a tab icon from hundreds of searchable icons, an emoji (including your custom emoji), or upload your own picture.

Badges now come in three kinds: a dot for unread rooms, a gray number for silent notifications and a red number for noisy ones (mentions, keywords, and messages whose notification rule plays a sound). Home, People and space numbers count messages.
Several pictures sent as one reply now show as one picture mosaic under a single reply quote, with the text sent with them following without repeating the quote.
Voice messages can now be transcribed on Android too, on the phone itself (the audio never leaves it).

Deleting a message now removes all of it with one confirmation: every picture of a picture group, and the files and text you sent together (for messages sent from now on). A single picture's own menu still deletes just that picture.

The picture viewer's thumbnail strip now fills itself with older pictures, zooming in hides the room behind the viewer so the picture can fill the screen, and on phones you can swipe a picture or video up or down to close it.
Edit picture can now zoom in and out and go full screen for precise work, and the Redact tool lists Pixelate, Blur and Color, where Color lets you pick the box color.
The + under the spaces column can now create a normal room (text chat, voice chat, photo album, calendar) as well as a space.
The message menu's room-wide pin options now read "Pin for everyone" and "Unpin for everyone", so they're easy to tell apart from "Pin for me".
With "Read state per thread" on, reading new replies in an open thread no longer leaves an unread marker on the room and its space.
On desktop, with "Autofocus Message Input" on, the message box is ready to type in again when you come back to the Vommet window.
More things show the hand cursor on hover: settings radio and checkbox rows, tabs, segmented buttons and thread cards in the chat; the call button shows the arrow while you can't call.
On phones the emoji and sticker pack list is now a bar you swipe sideways, instead of a column on the left.
Long sticker pack names in pack settings are cut short so the row's buttons stay on screen.
On phones, the "Help on right-click" guide menu on empty parts of the app now needs a two-finger press and hold, so it no longer pops up when a finger rests on the chat.

On Android, a "New message" notification for a message that couldn't be decrypted yet now changes into the real message once it decrypts, and notifications for rooms you've read on another device now go away by themselves.
On macOS, Update in the new-version bar can now save the download to your Downloads folder (it failed before).
Settings › App icon no longer says the icon is used for your launcher and app menu in the Flatpak and on Windows, where that can't change.
On touch screens, long-pressing a link now shows a highlight that spreads from your finger across the link and fills it as the press gets close to copying.

New --start-in-tray launch option for Linux and Windows (e.g. for autostart): Vommet starts hidden in the tray with no window or splash screen, even with Close to tray off; launching it again opens the window.
iOS: saving a theme in the theme editor no longer shows a "File system watching is not supported" error.
Links in someone's status message on their profile can now be tapped.
Saving an edit without changing the text no longer marks the message "Edited".
A room's menu now shows "Tags…" near the top, where you set Favorite and Low priority; the separate "Set as Favorite" item is gone.
When adding an existing room to a space, a "Not in any space" filter shows only rooms that aren't in any of your spaces yet.
Add contact (New Home People) and Add friend no longer show a person and then drop them while you type their full Matrix ID.
With New Home on, right-click a one-to-one DM in the DM list, or its title at the top of the chat, to add the person as a contact.
A DM request you accept before anything was said now goes to the top of your DM list.
The "all pinned messages" button on the pinned message bar now closes the pinned messages panel when you click it again.
Copying a single selected message no longer puts the sender's name in front of its text.
"Jump to latest" now reaches the newest message in one click after you scroll far back by hand.

Settings › Appearance › App icon now has one choice for everywhere — the Rainbow V (the new default) or the original — including your launcher, home screen or Dock, and "Show all options" lets you pick per place or upload your own image.

More clickable things show the hand cursor on desktop: emoji reactions, attachments, call panels, space folders, the message menu, New Home cards, People, the Media tab, threads, forwarding, message selection, settings pages and more.
On phones, long-press a link in a message to copy it.
Fewer wasted key backup requests: a message key the backup doesn't have is no longer asked for again by every undecryptable message.
New Home: the Overview uses much less memory on big accounts (only the rooms on screen are built).
Messaging a contact with several accounts now opens your existing DM from whichever of your accounts has it, and says so when a new DM can't be started.
On iPhone and iPad, matrix: links now open in Vommet.
On phones, picking another Home tab now switches the side list to that tab instead of jumping to its main page; swipe to see the page, or tap the tab again.

Home tabs can hold several views, shown as a bar you tap or swipe; People now opens on Contacts with Invites (with its count) and Blocked as views, there's a new Direct messages full-size card, and you can remove every tab (Home then offers Customize).

Customize Home: the Side list | Views switch lists a tab's views — add one (Direct messages, Contacts, Invites, Blocked, People, Rooms, or a view of cards), drag to reorder, rename or remove; "Whole pages" is now "Full-size cards".
New Home: the Tag and All my tags cards are now one Tags card that shows all your tags or the ones you pick, as a section per tag or one list, with a name of your own.
New Home: a Live calls card shows every room with a call going on, who's in it and for how long, with a Join button (add it from the Card library).
New Home: a Text card holds your own words with Markdown, images and up to three buttons that open a link, a room or a Vommet screen (add it from the Card library).
Canceling a direct-message invite you sent from People › Invites works again; for a group DM where that isn't possible, Vommet now says why.
The People button's badge now shows unread direct messages (it stayed empty because of an error).

Settings and Room Settings work better in narrow windows: the tab you're on stays open when the window shrinks, the tab list turns into a row of icons down the side, and in very narrow windows the tab's header shows "Settings ›" so you know where the back arrow goes.
Notification settings now show on Windows, macOS, iOS and web too, so you can set your account's notification defaults and the level new rooms get from any device.
Notifications now go away once a chat is read, including when you read it on another device (Linux, Android, Windows).
On Android, notifications for chats you read on another device now close even while the app is closed (one account signed in).
On Android 12 and later, Settings › General shows whether matrix.to links open in Vommet and takes you to Android's "Open by default" page to turn it on; macOS builds now open matrix: links too.
A message link for a room on another account now jumps to the message after you switch accounts.

Link previews that the sender's app attaches to a message (as Beeper does) now show without asking your homeserver for the link, so they also work in encrypted chats; the first one in each chat asks before showing, since the sender writes it.

When you type a link, Vommet now makes its preview on your device and attaches it to the message (encrypted in encrypted chats), so the people you send it to see the preview without anyone asking their homeserver for the link; tap × above the message box to send without it.
Buttons, toggles, room and DM entries, settings and menus show the hand cursor on desktop when you can click them.
The room's Media tab and room banners load faster, and scrolling through thumbnails is smoother.
While you pinch the Media grid, the number of thumbnails per row now changes live to what it will settle on.
Zooming in on a picture in the media viewer now smoothly fades out the counter, arrows and thumbnail strip, and brings them back once it's back to its original size.
Messages have a "Copy message link" option that copies a link Element also opens, and opening a link to a message jumps to it (no more offer to join a room you're already in).
Settings › About has a Check for updates button: it shows the new-version bar when a release is out, or tells you you're on the latest version.
Browse rooms now shows each room's topic under its name, and joining a space's room from the room list shows its topic and member count before you confirm.
On the Overview, the Active Now card now shows people in one row you swipe sideways, with the most recent activity first.
Fixed "Select text" in the message menu doing nothing on Android.

A room the server dropped you from without telling the app (for example one a server admin deleted) now says "You're no longer in this room." in place of the message box, with Rejoin and Forget, instead of letting every message fail silently.

Large accounts start much more smoothly: the app no longer floods the server with profile, member, thumbnail and message-history requests at once, and the search index now waits for the start to finish and paces itself.
Long text reactions no longer push the emoji and the add-reaction button out of the message menu's reaction row.
With a thread open, a dropped file is attached only to the composer of the area you drop it on, not to both.
Swipe to reply now works on phones: swiping a message leftwards from near the right edge of the screen starts a reply even on short messages.

Room Settings has a new Media page showing all of a room's pictures and videos, and resizing Media thumbnails with a pinch or Ctrl + mouse wheel is now animated, with the grid zooming live under your fingers.

Forwarding from the Select bar now waits above the message box like other forwards, so you can check it, show or hide the sender's name, and confirm; forwards now leave out the sender's name by default and remember your last choice.

The tray and taskbar badge now counts chats with notifications (each chat once, like Element), in-app badges count up to 99 instead of stopping at 9+, and the People button shows unread direct messages.
In the chat bubble layout, DMs show avatars and names again, the same way as group rooms.
On phones, a message's menu has "Select text" so you can select and copy just part of the message.

On Windows and Linux the media viewer has a full-screen button next to the zoom buttons: it shows only the picture or video across the whole screen. Click a picture or press Esc to go back; on a video use the X in the corner or Esc.
Desktop notifications no longer go off for messages (often pictures) that merely contain your name without mentioning you, matching the server and other apps.
Pinned rooms and DMs on the sidebar now load sharp icons too instead of staying slightly blurry on phones.
"Close to tray" is now on by default on Windows and Linux: closing the window keeps Vommet running in the tray (turn it off in Settings › App › Window behaviour). Without a tray, closing still quits.
With two or more accounts, Customize Home lets you pick which account your Home layout is saved to, so all your devices can share the same Home.
On desktop you can now click and drag the picture viewer's thumbnail strip with the mouse; the mouse wheel still works too.
Flatpak updates now show the command that installs them, so updating works on desktops without a software center.
Messages that arrived while the app was away no longer go missing under sliding sync: the room fetches them when you open it.
Friends and New Home contacts can now link several Matrix accounts of one person into one contact (⋮ › Link another account), with one combined status and a choice of account when you message them.
Settings → Appearance has a "Sticker size" slider (64–256 px) for how big stickers appear in the timeline; GIFs keep their size.
On iOS, drag your finger down onto the keyboard to hide it while chatting; scrolling the chat works as before.
On phones, swipe a message from the right edge to the left to reply to it; swipes that start further in still open the side panels.

With New Home on, Overview starts with Favorites and Direct messages beside Invites, Recent activity and Standalone rooms (also after Reset, and for anyone who never changed it); the Customize button sits at the right edge of the header; and Customize Home's Side list / Main page switch no longer gets stuck after changing tabs.
With New Home on, Customize Home has an Undo button (and Ctrl+Z) that takes back your changes one at a time, back to how Home was when you opened it.
Space icons on the sidebar now load sharp on their own instead of staying slightly blurry until you open the space.
Opening someone's profile is much faster: it shows right away and fills in their pictures and colors as they arrive.
On iPhone and iPad, the + button now offers Photo Library, Take Photo, Record Video and Choose File instead of only opening Files.
Android: the status bar icons now stay dark on the light theme, also after the theme follows a system light/dark switch.
Pressing Enter in the password field now signs you in.
Images and files sent while replying now go out as replies.
Right-clicking a message in an open thread now always opens its menu.
Rooms now remember where you scrolled to: switch away from a room you scrolled up in and come back, and it opens at the same messages instead of the newest ones (until the app restarts).
Making a sidebar folder by holding one space over another is easier: the spot that makes a folder is bigger, so you don't have to hit the exact middle.
A DM's Profile tab now has the Add contact button, like the profile card.
The side panel's Media and Files tabs now show a header for each month, like the Links tab.
Media and files: an expand button lets the Media, Files and Links tabs fill the window on desktop, and Ctrl + mouse wheel (or a pinch) makes the Media thumbnails bigger or smaller.
In a narrow window, settings now show the list of pages full-width and open each page full-width with a back arrow.
In the "One list" chat list, voice rooms now move up only when someone sends a message or joins the call, not on background call activity.
The theme editor's "Selected room" color now also highlights the open chat in the Home column's lists.

Set a notification level on all the group rooms you're already in at once (Settings → Notifications → "Apply to rooms I'm in now…"), and Discord-style space notifications: right-click a space → Notifications sets a level for its rooms, and rooms you join in it later follow it.
Windows: Vommet can now keep an icon in the system tray, and "Close to tray" hides the window there instead of quitting (Settings › General › Window behavior).

With New Home on, the side list's section headers (Favourites, Recent activity, Direct messages) show a red number only for mentions and keywords, and a red dot for a new direct message, instead of counting every unread message.
With New Home on, a Home tab's sidebar button (like People) stays highlighted while you have a room open from its list, instead of the highlight jumping to Home.
With New Home on, the narrow icon-only sidebar now shows the same Home tabs and rooms as the full one, following the tab you picked.
Picture gallery experiment: a strip of thumbnails under the picture viewer; tap one, use the mouse wheel over it, or drag it on phones to move between pictures.
In the Telegram-style chat list, right-clicking a folder tab that holds one space now offers Browse rooms, to see and join the space's other rooms.

The new-version bar can now download the right update for your install, check its signature and open the installer (or swap in a new AppImage); Nix and Guix installs get their update command. Settings › General › New releases: Off, Notify and ask, or Download automatically.
The first "Still have your recovery key?" check-in now comes 2 weeks after setup instead of 3 days, and a newly signed-in device (approved by emoji or with your key) isn't asked for 2 weeks.
Search now opens right in the chat: matches show as you type, tap one to jump to it with your search words highlighted, and step through the rest with the arrows.

Search in encrypted chats is now much faster: Vommet builds a search index on your device in the background (Settings › Privacy › Search: Off, Wi-Fi only or Always), and older messages are only ever fetched once.

A DM's side panel now has tabs at the top: Profile (with counts of the photos, GIFs, files, voice messages and links shared in the chat), Media, Files, a new Links tab, Threads, Pins and Widgets; Media can be narrowed to Photos, Videos or GIFs and Files to Files or Voice, with voice messages playing right in the list.
The theme editor's "Selected room" color now also highlights the open chat in the "One list" chat list.
Room tags: tag rooms from their menu (Tags…), and with New Home add any tag, or All my tags, as a card or side list section on any Home tab; tags are shared with other Matrix apps such as Nheko.
New installs now make new rooms unencrypted unless you turn encryption on; existing installs keep encrypting new rooms.
Rooms you left and joined again open normally instead of showing "Error loading timeline".
Reloading the web app on a big account no longer freezes for most of a minute while your contacts' device keys load.
Big accounts load rooms' member lists without a slowdown that grew with every room you're in.
Visible text now uses American spelling everywhere, e.g. "Favorite this sticker", the "Favorites" card and "Verification canceled".

With New Home on, Home is now a set of tabs: Overview (favourites and recent activity beside mentions, invites and who's active), People and Rooms, each with its own side list of collapsible sections and its own main page, saved to your account.

Customize Home lets you add, rename, reorder, duplicate and remove Home tabs, pick each tab's side list sections and main page cards, start a new tab empty, as a copy or from a removed default, and reset Home to default; first-time tips explain how it works.

Every Home tab can have its own sidebar button ("Show in sidebar" or the pin in Customize Home; right-click to hide it), with the icon you picked; the People and Rooms shortcut settings moved into Customize Home.
With New Home on, the sidebar's Home button always opens your first Home tab and is highlighted while you're in Home, and the Rooms button opens Rooms on "All", so search finds every room and space.

Settings › Appearance and first-time setup let you pick the original icon or a new rainbow V for the window and tray icon and, separately, for the splash screen, and make the tray icon black or white; the window and tray now default to the rainbow V.
Send-as patterns: send from another account with a prefix, a suffix or around the message like (this), with several patterns per account (Settings › Manage Accounts › account menu).
When your computer goes to sleep (macOS and Linux), Vommet now leaves the call you're in, so others don't keep seeing you there.
Android: message notifications have Reply and Mark as read buttons, and tapping a notification that arrived while Vommet was closed opens that chat again.
On Android you can now turn off in-app notification banners in Settings › Notifications to get system notifications instead.
On phones, direct messages now show the call button in the top bar, so you don't have to open the member drawer to call.
Ctrl+PgUp and Ctrl+PgDown now switch to the previous or next room, like Alt+Up and Alt+Down.
Searching an unencrypted room with only from:@user now lists that person's messages instead of "no results".
Settings: the picked option in two- and three-option buttons (Layout, theme mode, title bar, Redacted mode) is now filled with the theme's accent colour, so it shows on OLED themes too.
Tapping round buttons (like the settings back button) no longer flashes a solid white circle over the icon on the Amoled theme.
On the web version, the theme editor can now save and export custom themes (export downloads a .zip), and saved or imported custom themes show up and apply there.
Web: after sending a pasted image or other attachment you can type in the message box again right away.
Signing in on a big account no longer freezes the app while your message history keys are restored.

New installs now start with New Home, the People and "Standalone rooms" buttons and GIF search turned on (existing installs keep their settings); first-run setup explains the Home shortcuts and the encryption choice more clearly, and "rooms outside spaces" is now called "Standalone rooms" everywhere.
New Home's Overview now uses the full window width, has a visible "Customize" button in its header, and ends with an "Add a card" tile.

The New Home Rooms page now uses the full window width, wraps its filter chips instead of cutting them off, lists every room in each section (no more "Show N more"), and remembers which sections you collapsed.
With New Home on, someone's profile card now has an "Add contact" button under Message (with Undo), and for people already in your contacts it becomes a "Contact" menu to remove them or open People.

On Linux and Windows, a new room invite now pops up a "Room Invite" notification (or an in-app banner while Vommet is focused, if in-app banners are on), and the Home icon's badge counts invites waiting for you.
Hovering a chat or room name that's cut off in the left panel now shows the full name; names that fit show nothing.
With chat bubbles on, a thread under your own message now sits under its bubble on the right instead of on the far left.
Spoiler pictures and videos blur again when you leave the room and come back, like Telegram; turn it off in Settings › General › Media › "Hide spoilers again".
After you accept a verification request, both devices now say they're connecting instead of asking you to accept again.
Renaming a session that's offline no longer makes it show "Active now" in Settings › Sessions.
The welcome screen no longer briefly shows "Join #vommet:nether.im" to people who are already in the room; the offer only fades in once it's clear you're not a member.
Deleting several selected messages now asks "Delete for me" or "Delete for everyone"; "for me" hides them on all your Vommet devices, with Undo.
New setting in Notifications: get notified when someone reacts to one of your messages (off by default, skips muted rooms).
With rooms from spaces shown as separate chats, a room's menu (and a single-space folder's tab) now has Space settings.
Alt+Up/Down and Alt+Shift+Up/Down now switch chats in the Telegram-style chat list too, stepping into a space's rooms and back out.
New Home on phones: Overview, People and Rooms now open like a chat, so you can swipe back to the list instead of pressing back.
Direct messages show the chat's topic (for example the game a bridged Steam friend is playing) as a small line under their name in the chat lists.
Selecting several messages now works inside threads too, with its own selection bar; a thread's selection is separate from the room's and clears when the thread closes.

New Home (experiment) gets a People page for contacts, invites and blocked people, an optional People button in the sidebar, and a Rooms page that searches every room and space with filters for voice rooms, photo albums, calendars and unread.

New Home (experiment) lets you customize Overview: drag cards in from a Card library (Unread, Mentions & highlights, Invites, Active Now, Low priority, a Space, Contacts, and more Recent activity cards), reorder or remove them, and restore the defaults, with a reorder list on phones.
On phones, one swipe from the room list back to Home now works instead of snapping back to the room list; quick flicks between panels count too.

Selecting several messages: drags can start beside a message, dragging back unticks messages, on touch a long press can be dragged on to tick more (with auto-scroll), and in the desktop layout on a touch screen a tap opens the message menu.
Editing a message no longer turns links with their own text into plain text.
Messages you send from another account with an account-switch prefix now show "Sending as …" above the message box until they appear in the timeline, with Retry if sending fails.
Connection lost and screen shares starting or stopping now play a sound by default (the leave and join sounds); you can still set each to None in Settings › Sounds.
The hang-up button in the call view no longer looks greyed out and now reacts when you hover over or press it.
Settings › Calls › Call Connection lets you choose your own fallback STUN server (default stun:turn.matrix.org, with a reset button).
The theme editor has a new "Selected room" colour for the open room's highlight in the room list.
The "New messages" divider now uses your theme's accent colour, so custom themes change it too.
With chat bubbles on a light theme, your own messages now use a softer light blue that keeps the time readable.
The web app no longer hangs on the splash screen when browser storage is full or limited (e.g. some private windows), and starts much faster with many rooms.
Messages sent while one of a recipient's devices couldn't be reached right away now reach that device with a later message, instead of never.
New Home (experiment): Overview, Friends and Rooms in the Home column, with customizable cards on Overview.
Widgets now work in the web app (web.vommet.app).
Messages you send right after signing in on a new device can now be read by everyone in the room, instead of showing "Failed to decrypt" for people the app hadn't found the devices of yet.
Vommet no longer keeps asking the server about people it can't look up, so rooms that mention them load with less network traffic.
The member list no longer downloads a big room's whole member list again every time you open the room.
Pictures that can't be loaded (deleted, or on an unreachable server) are no longer requested over and over.
Avatars and room or space icons set as SVG pictures now show up instead of just their letter.
Room topics no longer go missing from the room header in the web app until you reload.
Spaces you haven't arranged in Vommet now appear in the same order as in Element, and follow it when you reorder them there.
Vommet is ready a few seconds sooner after launch on slower computers.
Room and space Security settings now offer who can read history, Preview space (spaces), guest access and Ask to join; rooms that use Ask to join no longer show as Private.
Room and space Permissions now match Element: more permission rows, a Privileged users list where you can change or add roles, and a Banned users list with Unban.
Room settings now have per-room URL previews and a Leave button in General, an Advanced tab for everyone (also for spaces), and a Bridges tab when the room is bridged.

Recovery key check-ins are now shared by all your Vommet devices (pass on one and the others won't ask), worded for whether you chose a key, phrase or password, can read your key from a file, and can be turned off in Settings › Security (not recommended); after 3 "Remind me later"s in a row the check-in waits for an answer.
New widget: Luanti, a shared creative block world (opens in your browser; experiment).
Drawpile canvases now open on Nether's own Drawpile server, so a shared canvas is always ready to join instead of failing with "Login error".
Right-clicking the # button for rooms outside spaces now also offers "What's a space?".
Vommet catches up faster after launch on slower computers.
Messages that couldn't be decrypted now fix themselves once you verify this device or unlock your key backup, without "Retry Decrypt".
First-run setup's layout page now has a switch for the # "Rooms outside spaces" button in the sidebar (on for new users), so rooms that aren't in a space are easy to find.
Voice messages now record on Windows, and voice-message hints (like "microphone unavailable") show up on desktop.
New "New rooms" setting under Notifications: choose the notification level (for example Mentions & Keywords) that rooms and direct chats get when you join them.
The two "rooms in sidebar" settings now say which part of the sidebar they change, and the # button for rooms outside spaces is on for new users; right-click it (or long-press on mobile) to hide it.

Right-click (or press and hold) any GIF in a chat and pick "Add to My GIFs" to save it; your GIFs show in the GIF tab even when GIF search is off, and first-run setup now asks whether to turn GIF search on.

New Help and guides: right-click (or press and hold) almost anything and pick the question at the bottom of the menu, like "What's a space?", for a short guide with pictures; all guides plus a Getting started walkthrough are in Settings › Help and guides, and new installs get the walkthrough once after signing in.

New Settings › Appearance › Layout: pick Discord style (today's look), Telegram style (one chat list, bubbles, captions under pictures, narrower messages) or mix the options yourself. The Telegram-style chat list moved here from Experiments.

The recovery key check-in now says "That's the one. Keep it safe." inside its own dialog (it closes by itself) instead of a message that often didn't show, and check-ins you keep passing come further apart: 30, then 90, then every 180 days.
Vommet shows its window sooner after launch, especially on slower computers and on accounts with many devices.
Your name and picture at the bottom left now update as soon as you change them in Edit profile, instead of after a restart.

Importing a sticker pack now asks whether to use it as stickers, emoji or both, with Stickers picked by default, so imported stickers stop turning up as emoji; the "Emoticons" settings tab is now "Emoji & Stickers".
Add friend now looks people up as you type, people you have DMs with first, and won't add a Matrix ID that doesn't exist.
On Linux, Drawpile now opens in Vommet's own widget window instead of failing there.
In a room's Media tab, the picture viewer's left and right arrows now follow the order of the thumbnails.
Fixed voice room participants briefly showing under other rooms in the sidebar after joining sub-spaces.
On Linux, the tray icon now shows a red badge with your unread count (Settings › Window behavior › "Unread badge on tray icon", on by default).
Captioned pictures sent as replies from bridges (WhatsApp and others) show their caption again.
Custom themes can now set their own colors for your chat bubbles and for other people's (Theme editor › Message bubbles); unset ones keep the automatic colors.
While selecting several messages on desktop, Ctrl+C copies them and the Delete key asks to delete them.
If you replaced your recovery key in an earlier test build, the old key's leftover copies of your secrets are removed the next time you enter your current key, so the old key really stops working.
If old copies of your secrets still wait for your current recovery key, the "Still have your recovery key?" check-in now comes at the next start instead of weeks later, so the cleanup can finish.
Restoring message history after sign-in is much faster.
Vommet does much less database work after each sync, so it stays responsive on slower computers.
In the Telegram-style chat list on desktop you can drag the list's edge to resize it (double-click resets it); the width is kept after a restart.
The Telegram-style chat list shows the unread dot again for new messages in rooms set to "Mentions & keywords" (and their spaces), even when they don't mention you.
The Friends tab now opens on All friends, listed online first, then friends whose presence isn't known, then offline.
On phones you can swipe the formatting row (Aa) to the right to close it, just like tapping Aa.
The locked Call button now says which room permission is missing ("Join Call") and where to change it (Room settings › Permissions).
The room list and home screen do much less work after each sync, so Vommet feels faster on slower computers.
Space and room avatars and banners no longer stay empty until you open the space or room (most visible in Firefox on the web).
On the web in Firefox, space avatars no longer show as black squares in the WebAssembly build, and space colours no longer log an error at startup.
Settings › Security is easier to read: your recovery key has its own row, "Reset encryption" is set apart and explained, and you can rename your sessions.
After you enter your recovery key or approve from another device, Vommet opens right away and restores older messages in the background.
On a slow device, the secure messaging setup now still asks after signing in, and "Approve from another device" no longer fails while the first sync is still loading.
When signing in through your browser, Vommet now shows the sign-in link to copy, plus "Open again" and "Cancel", instead of just spinning if the browser doesn't show up.
Switching rooms no longer gets slower the longer Vommet stays open: rooms you leave are now released instead of piling up in memory.
New opt-in experiment "Friends tab": Home gets a Friends tab with the people you add, who's online, Active Now (calls a friend is in) and suggestions from your DMs; your list is private.
A folded subspace in the room list now shows a headphones mark when people are in a call inside it (screen-share mark when someone is live).

New in Settings › Security: "Let people who join later read my messages" (also per room in Room settings › Security). People you invite now also get your own messages from before Vommet marked keys as shareable, when the room's history was visible to new members back then.
Settings › Developer Utils has a frame counter: frames drawn per minute and, on Linux, how often the window was redrawn, to help track down idle CPU use.
The Docked widgets experiment now works on macOS too: widgets dock in the room or call, pop out to their own window without reloading, dock back, and a video's full screen button goes full screen.

Fresh installs now start with a short, skippable setup: pick your language, a Discord-like or Telegram-like layout, a theme, Cozy or Compact message spacing, and whether new rooms are encrypted; run it again from Settings › General.

The verification dialog has a clear screen for every step, closes itself with a short note when another of your devices answers the request (instead of showing "KeyVerificationState.error"), and the recovery-key step and number comparison now work.

Direct messages in chat lists now show an amber icon when they aren't encrypted and a red one when the other person's identity changed, and calls that aren't encrypted keep a short note above them for the whole call.
When creating a room or space, or upgrading a room to version 12, you can name co-owners who get the same full power as you.
The Docked widgets experiment now works on Windows too: widgets dock in the room or call, pop out to their own window without reloading, dock back, and go properly full screen.
Docked widgets (Linux experiment): a video's full screen button now really goes full screen, and a popped out widget no longer shows a black window.
macOS: a room's widgets open again (in the app, or in your browser from the widget menu).
Linux: text you select in a chat or the message box is copied to the primary selection, and a middle-click in the message box pastes it, like in other Linux apps.
"Replace my recovery key" now really retires the old key: it can no longer unlock your cross-signing and backup keys.
Messages you send now reach bridge bots (e.g. Telegram bridges) in encrypted bridged rooms, even when Vommet's copy of the bot's keys was out of date.
People you invite to an encrypted room get more of its earlier messages: keys their senders marked as shareable no longer lose that mark when this device gets an earlier copy of them.
Desktop notifications now work right after signing in, without restarting the app.
Videos posted in rooms on servers without HTTP range support (nether.im) play again instead of showing a black box.
Animated stickers, emotes and GIFs keep playing on Android while a chat bubble or split screen has focus, and turning off "Pause animations when unfocused" restarts paused ones at once.
The welcome screen no longer offers to join #vommet:nether.im when you're already in it.
The picture button in the Add File dialog is now called "Edit picture", since it also lets you draw on and redact the picture, not just crop or rotate it.

New experiment on Linux (Settings > Experiments > Docked widgets, off by default): widgets open inside Vommet's window, beside the room or above a voice room's call, and can be popped out into their own window and docked back without reloading.
Key files exported from Vommet import into Element with all their keys.
Messages you send decrypt in Element again in rooms where they had stopped (an older message key with a bad shared-history mark is replaced), and your key backup is repaired for Element.
New to Matrix? The login screen now has "Create an account": a short tutorial, the servers nether.wiki recommends, and sign-up right in the app where the server allows it.
Your own chat bubbles are now readable on the AMOLED theme.
Turning Redacted mode on or off can no longer leave the app as a grey, unresponsive screen.
Redacted mode now also covers link previews and thread summaries (the card under a thread and the threads list).
Opening a room from a notification or a link now opens its top-level space instead of the subspace it sits in, and stays in the space you have open if the room is in it.
The image viewer has zoom buttons with the zoom level under the picture on desktop; click the picture to zoom in around the pointer (double tap on phones), and + / − / 0 on the keyboard.

The "show room pictures only" button no longer sits on the space banner: it's in the space menu now, Ctrl+Shift+B (Cmd+Shift+B on Mac) toggles it, and dragging the room list's edge far enough narrow collapses it (drag the collapsed edge back out for names).
Alt+Up and Alt+Down switch to the previous or next room in the room list, and Alt+Shift+Up or Alt+Shift+Down jump to the previous or next room with unread messages.

Clicking the "connecting", "disconnected" or "connected" notice in the corner now hides it, so it no longer covers the controls under it; a dismissed notice stays hidden until the connection works again.
Web: signing in no longer hangs in Firefox while it asks about persistent storage.
Web: attaching an image works in the WebAssembly build.
Web: images, stickers and files from others load, and uploads go through, in the WebAssembly build.
Web: Vommet now runs in the browser as WebAssembly (with an automatic fallback for older browsers), loads its fonts from its own site instead of Google, and images can be pasted into the composer.
The web app's first load is about half the size: it no longer downloads a 24 MB emoji font up front.
Chat bubbles: on wide windows all bubbles now sit on the left, yours with your avatar and name.
With "Open at last read message" on, rooms whose last read message can't be loaded now open at the latest messages instead of failing with "Error loading timeline".
On Linux, opening or focusing a chat now closes its desktop notifications.
On desktop, scrolling over any section of the settings sidebar now scrolls the whole sidebar.
The text you type in the message box now follows the system "Bold text" setting too.
The Open Link prompt can now always open links to a domain you trust; Settings › Privacy lists trusted domains so you can remove them.
New in Settings › Appearance: "Sidebar icon size", a slider that makes the space sidebar's icons smaller (40 px is Discord's size) or bigger; the default look is unchanged.
On macOS, signing in with your homeserver's login page now opens your default browser instead of always Safari.
Redacted mode now also hides names and text in the pinned message bar and the names in join, leave and profile-change lines.
On a Mac, pasting a link copied in Safari pastes the link again instead of showing "Couldn't attach file".
Watch Together and other widgets that sign you in now work in Vommet's own widget window on Linux and Windows instead of waiting forever on "Confirming who you are".
The separate widget window is now titled "Vommet | <widget name>" (for example "Vommet | Watch Together") instead of showing "commet | Widget Runner" in quotes.

The button that shrinks the room list to room pictures now sits in the list's top row (next to the space name or the search box), and the edges you can drag to resize the room and member lists light up when you point at them.
In a narrow desktop window the panel toggle now opens the member list (with its Widgets, Pins and other tabs) over the chat instead of doing nothing, and its arrow shows whether the panel is open.
With Encryption markers on, a room's topic is no longer cut in half at large font sizes; it moves onto the name's line when two lines don't fit.
Older messages restored from key backup keep decrypting after you reload Vommet for Web or restart the app.
A device you just signed in on can be approved from another device (including Element) even on big accounts, and the setup screen and Settings › Security notice when another device confirms it.
Element users can read the messages you send in rooms with shared history again (testing builds since the 16th sent message keys Element rejected).
The "disconnected" badge no longer flashes for a sync that fails once and recovers; it shows after 20 seconds without a working connection.

On Linux, widgets open in Vommet's own window instead of needing Chromium (Settings › General › Widgets, or a widget's menu, can send them to your browser), the Flatpak no longer asks for "Arbitrary Permissions", and "Open on a nearby device" explains how it works.
The Home side pane now lists rooms that aren't in any space under "Rooms", below Direct Messages, so they stay in reach while a chat is open; the search field filters them by name.
The room list marks the open room again after switching spaces, and the open thread's first message is shaded in the chat so you can tell which thread is open.
Blocking someone now also removes their last message from room previews right away.
The Timestamps experiment's description no longer calls $[…] "Sable" syntax; it's described as the short form of <t:…>.
Theme editor: the "Space rail" color is now called "Popups", since it colors tooltips, menus and link previews; saved themes are unchanged.
On Android, swiping Vommet away from recent apps during a call now hangs up, so you no longer stay shown in the call.

When an account gets signed out (for example from another device), Vommet now shows an "Account signed out" alert that takes you to Settings to remove it or sign in again, instead of a silent "Error".
Telegram-style chat list: a new option shows every room from your spaces as its own chat, newest first, and folders can now hold a space's rooms.
On phones, the formatting row (Aa) now hides when you tap away from the message box or close the keyboard, and comes back when you return to typing.
Voting in a poll no longer adds "Unknown Event Type" rows to the chat; votes only count towards the poll.
New in Settings › Appearance: "Chat bubbles" shows messages as bubbles, yours on the right and everyone else's on the left (off by default).

On desktop the chat keeps its room as you narrow the window: the member list hides first, then the room list shrinks to room pictures, then the side column hides behind a menu button in the room header; a button at the foot of the room list collapses it by hand.
Tap a sticker in a chat to see the rest of its pack and add the pack to your own packs, a room, a space or a sticker room.
Select several messages: on a computer, drag from one message into another; on a phone, long-press a message to select it and tap a message for its menu.
Right-click a space's icon in the sidebar, or long-press it and let go, to open the space menu; spaces and rooms in a folder get their full menu with "Remove from folder".
Widgets work in voice rooms again (watch together while you talk); widgets that would join the call themselves are kept out of it.
Inviting someone straight into an encrypted room now says whether its earlier messages go along, and lets you untick "Share earlier messages".
Android, iOS and macOS: long-press (or right-click) an enlarged image and pick "Share" to send it to another app.
Pictures in chat are no longer blurry when the sender attached a small preview: the full-size picture loads when the preview is too small for the screen.
Sending a file over your homeserver's upload limit now tells you the file's size and the limit, and Settings › Manage Accounts shows each account's max upload size.
Page Up and Page Down now scroll a room's timeline, and Home and End jump to the oldest loaded and the newest message.
Typing an emoji shortcode like :sob: now sends the emoji, even in the middle of a word, and custom emoji no longer get spaces forced around them.
Ctrl+Enter in the message box now adds a new line, like Shift+Enter, instead of sending.
The compact message hover bar now has Edit on your own messages.
A space's notification settings now say what they do: Mute hides the space's unread dot, and each room keeps its own notification setting.
The composer's "..." button now shows the pointer cursor on hover.
English text now uses American spelling everywhere (Behavior, color, favorite, canceled).
Settings › Appearance › Clock picks System default, 12-hour or 24-hour for message times and every other time in the app; desktop now follows the system's 24-hour setting.
Room and space settings have a "Publish to room directory" switch under Room Addresses, so you can list a room or space in Explore rooms or take it off.
Quitting the app during a call now hangs up first, so you no longer stay shown "in the call" afterwards.
Typing fast and pressing Enter no longer sometimes sends the message twice.
Unencrypted videos now start playing right away instead of waiting for the whole file to download.
Rooms full of joins and name changes (like announcement channels) now reach their real messages much faster when you scroll back.
A received picture that failed to load no longer stays blurred in the chat until you switch rooms.
Avatars that can't load now show the coloured letter instead of an empty box, and the @ mention list no longer shows your own picture next to someone else's name.
When two emoji packs have an emoji with the same name, the one you pick is now the one that gets sent.
Right-click menus now stay inside the window, and a menu taller than the window scrolls, so you can reach every option.
On desktop, pressing Esc closes the settings page (the first Esc clears an active settings search).
Unblocking someone (or being unbanned) while their chat is open no longer turns the chat grey; the message box comes back.
On phones, tapping a space no longer marks its reopened room as read before you've actually opened the chat.
A call in an ordinary text room now lights up its space's call mark on the left, not only calls in voice rooms.

Theme editor: the Raised color now also colors selected rows, and each color's description and the preview show where it really appears (the message box follows Room list, the space rail follows Window).
AMOLED theme: buttons, sidebar icons and room-list rows now show a visible hover highlight.
In the macOS app, Cmd+V now pastes a copied image or files into the message box.
Windows: an image copied with "Copy image" now pastes back into the message box.
The Flatpak no longer asks for an outdated codec extension; full video and audio codecs now come from the GNOME 51 runtime itself.
The in-app log no longer grows for the whole session; it keeps the newest 5000 entries, so long-running sessions use less memory.
Web: microphone and speaker lists show device names (or "Microphone 1", "Speaker 2") instead of blank rows.
Web: without WebGL the page now says how to turn it on instead of freezing.
In the new chat list (Experiments), you can now archive chats and sort them into folders with tabs, set up in Settings › Chat folders.
With the Telegram-style chat list, a voice room's speaker icon is green only while people are in the call, and grey when it's empty.
The forward picker can filter by space and open subspaces, and shows which space each room is in, so same-named rooms are easy to tell apart.
On foldable iPhones (iPhone Duo) Vommet keeps the chat off the fold, and a half-open phone standing like a laptop shows the call above the fold and its buttons below.
The Experiments page now describes "Encryption markers" and "Clearer subspaces and voice rooms" the way they actually work.
A room marked as unread in another app no longer keeps its unread dot in Vommet after you've read it.
A link whose preview can't be loaded no longer leaves a grey placeholder box under the message until you reopen the room.
Starting a direct message from a profile opened in the Read Receipts dialog now closes the dialog.
Reply and Reply in thread no longer show in the message menu in rooms where you can't send messages.
Messages starting with an emoticon like ">_>" are no longer sent as a quote; a quote needs "> " with a space.
Right-clicking a room in the room list now offers "Invite people" (when you can invite there).
The typing indicator no longer shows in an open thread when someone is typing in the main room.
Closing a thread no longer reopens the right panel when you had it closed, and the panel arrow stays in step.
Hovering a message in a narrow pane no longer pushes the time under the sender's name; the detailed time now shows over the end of the name instead.
Key files exported from Vommet keep the "can share history" mark when imported into Element.
The Direct Messages list has a search field: type a name, Matrix ID or nickname to find a conversation.
You can draw on a picture or hide parts of it (black, pixelated or blurred) in the editor before sending it.
On Android, images from your keyboard work in the message box: tap a copied image in Gboard's clipboard strip, or send a keyboard GIF or sticker. Each one opens the attachment preview first.
On Android you can paste an image into the message box (long-press the box, then Paste), whether you copied it in Vommet or in another app.

Dropping or pasting a file the app can't open now shows a message instead of doing nothing, and files copied in a file manager can be pasted into a chat (Ctrl+V) to attach them, including in the Flatpak.
With the Telegram-style chat list on a phone, Reply in Thread now keeps the cursor in the thread's message box.
With several accounts signed in, account settings now open on the account you've switched to instead of the first one you added.
On desktop, a Quit button next to the back button in Settings closes Vommet completely, even with "Minimize on close" on.
Copied system info in Settings › About now includes your OS version and no longer includes your phone's name or model.

On Linux (including the Flatpak), the window title bar now turns dark with a dark Vommet theme and stays light with a light one; Settings › Appearance › Theme › Title bar can force it light or dark for any theme.
The login page accepts a homeserver typed with http:// (e.g. a local test server at http://127.0.0.1:8008), and warns under the field when such an address isn't on this device.
Settings › Security no longer crashes when you tap Verify on a session that never shared encryption keys; it says "Can't verify" and explains why.

Vommet builds again for iPhone and Mac with current Xcode, asks before using the camera and microphone instead of crashing in calls, shows emoji and end-to-end encryption works there, and installs as "Vommet" beside Commet.
iPhones get the phone layout instead of the desktop one, and foldable iPhones keep the room list clear of the side status bar.
Redacted mode (experiment): Settings › Redacted mode hides names, pictures, messages and room names on screen at one of six levels, for screenshots and screen sharing.
Deleted messages leave a muted "Message deleted" line (with who deleted it and why, when that wasn't the sender) instead of vanishing; Settings › Experiments › Show deleted messages turns it off.
On desktop, Ctrl+↑ in the message box replies to the latest message (press again for older ones, Ctrl+↓ to go back or cancel).
Password managers can now fill in the login form, and offer to save your login after you sign in with a password.
Screen readers now read sidebar spaces, DMs, pinned rooms and the Home, Rooms, Add Space and Explore buttons by name, and red badges as "N unread notifications", instead of just "Button".
An upgraded DM now shows once in Direct Messages, as the new room; the old one is still reachable from the new room's "continues an older one" link.
An account that failed to load ("Error" in Manage Accounts) can now be removed with Logout, and its row says why it failed.
Settings › About and bug reports now show your real Linux distro and desktop in the Flatpak instead of "GNOME 48" and "wayland".
AVIF and HEIC pictures from other people now show as pictures (through the sender's thumbnail) instead of a black gap.
You can now edit your /me emotes, and edits to emotes made in other apps now show up.
Joining a room or accepting an invite that the server refuses now shows the server's error instead of spinning forever.
Account switch prefixes now keep a trailing space, so a prefix like "e " no longer catches every message starting with "e" (set your prefix again if it had a space).
The Flatpak no longer needs access to NetworkManager; calls work without it and the online check uses the desktop portal instead.
Kicked, banned or departed members now disappear from the member list (and its role sections) straight away instead of staying until a restart.
A link written as <https://example.org> is sent without a preview card, like on Discord, and links wrapped this way by other clients don't get one either.
Message search in encrypted rooms finds messages again when the search has capital letters or extra spaces (e.g. phone keyboard auto-capitalisation).
Voice notes from bridges and other clients that send "audio/ogg; codecs=opus" or a generic file type now play inline instead of showing as a download.
Calendar events that run past midnight now repeat their after-midnight part, and its title no longer shows the event's ID.
Links whose preview image is huge no longer crash the app; the preview shows without the image.
Fixed a crash when the app went to the background or came back while one of your accounts wasn't signed in.
On Windows, starting Vommet while Commet is running now opens Vommet instead of bringing Commet to the front.
SVG profile pictures, room and space icons and emotes now show instead of a blank placeholder.
"Reply in Thread" now puts the cursor in the thread's message box, also on Android, and on phones a hidden room or thread no longer keeps the keyboard.
After a room's icon changes, Android notifications and the room's launcher shortcut show the new icon (Windows notifications also pick up a sender's new avatar).
Timestamps written as `<t:…>` or `$[…]` are sent as a time again instead of an underlined "0".
Screen sharing with sound on Windows now sends the audio in stereo instead of mono.
With "Minimize on close" on, Vommet now still quits on logout, shutdown and a Close from the taskbar.
On Linux, Vommet has a tray icon (click to show or hide, menu with Quit), and a new "Close to tray" setting under Window Behaviour.
Noise suppression now works on Windows (and Android) microphones that run at a lower sample rate than 48 kHz, such as many headsets and Bluetooth mics.
